head.no_workspace: None (this project is not in a workspace)
start.none: {path} is neither a project nor a workspace.
start.created: A workspace was created in {path}. Optional keys go in its .env file.
start.not_created: No workspace was created. Start reelsmith in a project or workspace folder, or name one: reelsmith chat PATH.
start.create_failed: The workspace could not be created: {error}
engine.none_intro: No agent engine can run on this computer. Each engine and what it requires:
engine.none_next: Enable one as described, then restart the session. reelsmith doctor checks this computer.
engine.title: Agent engines
engine.hint: /engine ID selects the engine for the next requests.
home.title: Films in {workspace}
home.empty: This workspace has no films yet. Describe a new film to start one.
home.hint: Enter a number or a name to open a film, or describe a new film to start one.
home.unavailable: This project is not in a workspace's projects folder, so there is no list of films.
home.no_number: There is no film number {n}. /projects lists the films.
home.no_film: There is no film named "{name}". /new {name} creates it.
col.name: Name
col.title: Title
new.no_workspace: A new film requires a workspace. Start the session in a workspace folder.
new.confirm: Create the film {name} and send this text as its first request? [Y/n]
open.none: There is no project "{name}". /projects lists the films.
open.usage: Name the project: /open NUMBER or /open NAME.
open.other_window: A watch window of another process is open on {name} ({url}, process {pid}).
open.other_next: Close that window first, then open the project here. The session does not attach to a project another process is working on.
open.busy: The agent is working on request {turn}.
open.hint: Type a request for the agent. /status shows the film, /projects returns to the list.
status.title: {name}
turn.budget: The agent budget of {budget} is used up ({spent} spent). No request was sent.
turn.budget_now: This request used the remaining budget of {budget}.
turn.budget_next: Raise runner.budget_usd in workspace.json to continue.
turn.error_next: Check the engine with /engine or run reelsmith doctor, then send the request again.
turn.stopping: Stopping: the agent completes its current step first.
note.budget: the agent budget is used up
render.refused_next: Ask the agent to fix the cause, or use /check to list the issues; then /render again.
act.cannot_stop: This action cannot be interrupted. Press Ctrl+C again to return to the prompt while it continues.
act.background: The action continues; its result is shown here when it ends.
window.already: The window is already open on {url}.
window.browser: The desktop window is not available here (pip install "reelsmith[app]"). Open this address in a browser: {url}
window.failed: The window could not be opened: {error}. Open this address in a browser: {url}
lang.title: Interface languages
lang.hint: /lang CODE selects the language and saves the choice.
lang.not_saved: The choice could not be saved: {error}
cmd.need_project: Open a project first: enter its number or name, or use /open.
quit.again: Press Ctrl+C again to leave, or type /quit.
quit.stopping: Stopping the running request before leaving.
help.title: Commands
help.projects: Return to the list of films
help.open: Open a film by its number or name
help.new: Create a new film, optionally with the given name
help.status: Show the film's length, beats, issues, result and spend
help.window: Open the editor window on this session
help.engine: List the agent engines, or select one
help.lang: List the interface languages, or select one
help.text_home: Any other text describes a new film; the film is created after a confirmation.
help.text_project: Any other text is a request to the agent.
help.stop: Stop the request running on this film
keys.tab: Tab: complete a command, a film name, an engine or a language
keys.stop: Ctrl+C while the agent works: stop the request after its current step
keys.quit: Ctrl+C twice at an empty prompt, Ctrl+D or /quit: leave
keys.action: Ctrl+C twice during /check or /render: return to the prompt while the action continues
code.chat.too_long: The message has {chars} characters; the maximum is {max}.
code.chat.bad_context: The reference attached to the message is not valid.
code.chat.no_engine: No agent engine can run on this computer. /engine lists each engine and what it requires.
code.chat.workspace_hidden: A workspace.json inside the project hides the workspace; move it out of the project.
code.chat.error: The request could not be processed.
code.busy.chat: The agent is working on a request. Wait for it to finish, or stop it with /stop.
code.busy.render: A render or preview of this project is running.
code.project.invalid: The project does not load. /status shows the error.
code.render.current: The delivered film already matches the current cut.
code.undo.empty: There is no change to undo.
code.redo.empty: There is no undone change to restore.
code.stop.unsupported: A running action cannot be interrupted; it ends by itself.
code.accept.not_current: Only a delivered film that matches the current cut can be accepted.
code.action.render.ok: The film was rendered and delivered
code.result.current: The delivered film matches the current cut
code.result.stale: The delivered film predates the current cut
code.render.refused.layout: text lies where it cannot be read
code.render.refused.film_check: the film failed its delivery checks
code.layout.cut_by_edge: text "{text}" is cut by the {side} edge of the canvas ({px} px)
code.layout.outside_safe: text "{text}" lies {px} px outside the safe area ({side})
code.layout.text_tiny: text "{text}" is {px} px high, below the minimum of {min} px
code.layout.text_small: text "{text}" is {px} px high, below the recommended {min} px
code.layout.cut_by_card: text "{text}" is partly hidden by its own card ({share} %)
code.layout.low_contrast: text "{text}" has a contrast of {ratio}:1 against its background
code.layout.overflow_box: text "{text}" overflows its box by {px} px ({side})
code.create.empty: Enter a name for the film.
code.create.long: A name can be at most 64 characters long.
code.create.chars: A name can use only the letters A–Z, digits, hyphens and underscores, and cannot begin with a hyphen.
code.create.reserved: "{name}" is reserved by the operating system.
code.create.taken: A film named "{name}" already exists in this workspace.
code.create.failed: The film could not be created: {error}
code.owner.elsewhere: This film is open in another window ({url}). Requests and actions are available only there until that window is closed.
why.engine.sdk_missing: The Claude Agent SDK is not installed: pip install "reelsmith[runner]"
why.engine.cli_missing: The claude CLI was not found (neither bundled with the SDK nor on PATH)
why.engine.key_missing: {key} is missing: add it to the workspace .env file
why.engine.not_signed_in: No {key} is set and the claude CLI is not signed in: sign in to claude once, or add {key} to the workspace .env file
why.engine.codex_ready_default: Default model, using the Codex sign-in
why.engine.codex_sign_in: The Codex CLI is not signed in: run codex login once (it opens a browser)
why.engine.codex_missing: The Codex CLI was not found: install it with npm install -g @openai/codex, then run codex login once
why.engine.dsh_missing: DeepSeek Harness was not found: install Node.js (required for npx {package})
why.engine.dsh_ready_npx: {model} (npx downloads DeepSeek Harness on first use)
